title: Native+
description: A hand-picked Vanilla+ adventure designed for deep exploration. It's built for peak performance.
body:
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd270c29b90bb88bc1bead57c7493dd5d9451745.png)
### **The Native+ Project**

I’m building this pack for anyone who wants a more meaningful adventure without losing that classic Minecraft feeling. It’s currently a work in progress.I've hand-picked every mod to make sure they fit together perfectly—enhancing the world, the gear, and the difficulty while keeping the game running buttery smooth.

**What’s inside right now:**

- Reimagined Exploration: Discover massive new structure.

- Meaningful Progression: New gear like Advanced Netherite, custom tool trims, and hammers.

- Quality of Life: Traveler’s Backpacks, easy shulker access, and smarter animal feeding.

- Peak Performance: Fully optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix for high FPS.

- Immersive Atmosphere: Realistic 3D sound physics and dynamic lighting.

More features and balancing are coming soon as I continue to update it!
